scientific_domain: Operations Research / Exact Mixed-Integer Convex Certificate

synthesis_decision.rationale: [blinded_slot:candidate_a->antithesis] Both branches matched the public optimum of 195.791655576963 and verified that their leaves covered all 4,096 opening patterns exactly once. A returned 4 leaves with zero reported certificate gap and flow residual; B returned 13 leaves and passed the 1e-5 gap check. Both verified a stress case compacted to the 80-leaf cap. A's exhaustive oracle found no overstated leaf bounds on either the public or compacted cluster case. The mechanical metrics contain no facility result, and the task specifies no runtime cap. | A wins on a smaller verified public certif

nogoods_recorded.assumption_refuted: A zero relative MIP gap plus pruning at the requested certificate tolerance suffices to select the optimum in nearly symmetric facility instances.
nogoods_recorded.empirical_witness: On analytically solvable symmetric instances perturbed by fixed-cost spacings of 5e-8 and 5e-9, the incumbent exceeded the optimum by up to 5.00e-8 and 4.00e-8 respectively.
nogoods_recorded.causal_blanket_diagnosis: A support with a strictly better objective can be discarded by the certificate stopping rule before its transport optimum is evaluated.
nogoods_recorded.sublated_pivot: Separate incumbent search from proof compaction and evaluate every fixed support reached by the tighter search.

nogoods_recorded.assumption_refuted: Tightening the facility support search suffices to return the exact optimal objective.
nogoods_recorded.empirical_witness: With all 12 facilities forced open, a 1e-10 arc premium produced a 2.30e-9 objective excess over the analytic optimum of 36.
nogoods_recorded.causal_blanket_diagnosis: The support is uniquely determined; the remaining error is in transport flow selection under the LP dual feasibility tolerance.
nogoods_recorded.sublated_pivot: Solve fixed-support transport with exact integer costs and capacities representing the binary64 input, while retaining the linked LP to guide branching.

nogoods_recorded.assumption_refuted: Exact fixed-support transport alone preserves the certificate margin under common changes to unit transport costs.
nogoods_recorded.empirical_witness: The certificate gap grew from 2.84e-14 without an offset to 3.81e-6 at 1e9; at 1e11 certificate collection crashed on a terminal node despite the exact representability of the optimum.
nogoods_recorded.causal_blanket_diagnosis: Demand conservation makes the offset irrelevant to the optimizer, but absolute-cost dual arithmetic and unconditional downward rounding make the reported lower bound depend on that offset.
nogoods_recorded.sublated_pivot: Remove customer-specific cost constants before the LP, evaluate the capacity-knapsack dual in exact integer coordinates, and add the offset back before directed output rounding.
